messages:
incidentbot: ALERT: service=page-orch severity=high — 5xx rate spike on /v1/infer (us-east-1). auto-paged oncall; page_id=pgc-5812349123
maya: got the page — I don't see an ack in PD
sam: same, PD shows page delivered but incidentbot logs show 'claim acquired' then 'stale claim' and no webhook fanout
incidentbot: webhook delivery failure to pagerbridge: 401 Unauthorized (signing-key-rotation) at 5812349130
leo: ugh, did we rotate the signing key earlier today? ops-runner?
ops-runner: yes, rotation completed at 5812349000. looks like router cache didn't pick up new key for webhook calls
maya: paging bridge attempted fanout to sms & voice but got 409 / dropped, PD shows "delivered" but no ack recorded
tess: I'm manually paging erin via phone and PD direct-call now
erin: oncall here — got the manual page, investigating current traffic and logs
maya: impact: 3 VIP tenants saw increased error rates; fallback model was used, resulting in >5s latency and some 503s to their API clients
sam: mitigation in progress: scaling routing pool + routing traffic to read-only replicas; also toggling prefix cache bypass on inference path as temporary measure
leo: logs from claim manager: ```ERROR page-orch: orphaned claim id=cid-89033 ttl=0 action=drop
stack: ork/claim_manager.go:412
```
maya: candidate root cause: signing-key rotation caused pagerbridge webhook auth failures; incidentbot treats 401 as non-retriable and marks fanout as dropped (no retries)
ops-runner: rolling back key rotation now and pushing a hotfix to incidentbot to treat 401 as retriable after re-auth
sam: deploying incidentbot hotfix (canary 10% us-east-1) — /deploy incidentbot hotfix
deploy-bot: canary deployed: incidentbot v2.1.3-canary to 10% in us-east-1 at 5812349300
maya: after rollback+hotfix, paging retried and final delivery succeeded; erin acknowledged at 5812349325 :thumbsup:
erin: confirmed I have the full context, pairing with leo to patch claim manager to implement retry-on-orphan and increase TTL sanity checks. will write up follow-ups
tess: CS notified for affected customers, escalation INC-8612 created and assigned to maya for customer comms
maya: post-incident actions: 1) revert signing rotation flow to include staged key cache flush 2) add unit & e2e test for fanout retry on 401/5xx 3) surface metric 'page_orch.orphaned_claims' + alert 4) update runbook to include explicit key-rotation checklist and PD verification steps
sam: logging action items in ops-triage board. thanks for fast responses everyone
incidentbot: auto-incident resolved; closing auto-incident at 5812349470
